blocks.html: The data to request an order edit.

types.name: OrderEditRequestWorkflowInput
types.description: The data to request an order edit.

children.name: order_id
children.description: The ID of the order to request the edit for.

children.name: requested_by
children.description: The ID of the user requesting the edit.

children.name: no_notification
children.description:
Whether to prevent sending the customer a notification about the order edit.
The value is stored on the order change and passed to the emitted
`order-edit.requested` event, allowing subscribers to check it before sending
a notification.
